agents.name: Hypatia
agents.role: D-track curator (proof decomposition with R1-R5 ladder)

agents.name: Theseus
agents.role: substrate generation engine (catalog cross-product, mutation, triangulation, self-play)

agents.name: Pheme
agents.role: demand voicer — publishes per-pattern Learner-deficit profile

agents.name: Stygian
agents.role: v10-battery attack worker — picks Atlas number-theoretic problems, emits attack-plan artifacts with KillVector stubs (BL-C-001..010 + continuation)

agents.name: Lethe
agents.role: anti-anchor miner — cold LLM probes against recently-settled conjectures, scores false-form emissions, industrializes the Saxl-capture pattern

agents.name: Acheron
agents.role: HARD-5 coordinate-collision detector — Iris-complement; flags silent ambiguous-coordinate usage in prose substrate (e.g. tensor vs symmetric rank)

agents.name: Moros
agents.role: cross-pollination automator — multi-frontier-model adversarial critique on load-bearing artifacts (upstream of Phylax)

agents.name: Hecate
agents.role: continuous gradient archaeology — recomputes MI(kill_pattern, operator-class) over the kill ledger with permutation-null baseline; turns the 0.725-bit MI result into a live health signal

agents.name: Nephele
agents.role: Clio-fallback substrate gatherer — slow-roll arxiv RSS rotation, activates only when Clio has been silent ≥4h

agents.name: Erebos
agents.role: composer/forger — plugin host for 25 hypothesis-generator archetypes; reads Stygian+Pollux+Erebos ledgers and Hecate patterns to mint composed_claim artifacts (renamed from Hephaestus 2026-05-26 to avoid name collision)

agents.name: Pollux
agents.role: numerical-coincidence scanner — Spearman correlation before/after mean-spacing normalization on Mahler-measure subset pairs; the second non-Theseus operator class populating the kill_ledger
